list_projects.title: List Godot Projects
description: Lists the Godot projects that are available to open.
When the MCP is running with --global, this includes the projects registered in the project manager and those under the project base path.
Otherwise, this recursively searches the allowed root paths.

projects.description: The Godot projects that were found

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

project_name.description: The project's configured name; omitted if it couldn't be read

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

open_godot_project.title: Open Godot Project
description: Opens a Godot project in a new Godot editor instance, if it isn't already open.

Safe to call first for any project, open or not: one that is already open returns its running editor rather than starting a second one, so there is no need to check with list_open_projects beforehand.

An editor that is already open keeps the version of Godot and the display mode it was started with: headless, offscreen and offscreen_size are ignored for it, and asking for a godot_version it isn't running is an error rather than a silent no-op. Check already_open in the result to see whether an editor was already there.

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

headless.description: Launch the editor without visual or audio output (default: false). Mutually exclusive with offscreen.

offscreen.description: Launch the editor rendering normally, but to a virtual display nobody can see (default: false). Linux only, and needs Xvfb installed. Mutually exclusive with headless.

offscreen_size.description: The virtual display's size in pixels as WIDTHxHEIGHT, for offscreen (default: 1920x1080)

godot_version.description: Open the project with this version of Godot, regardless of the version the project itself asks for, installing it if it isn't installed yet. Use a version from list_installed_godot_versions. Leave this out to let Godai work out the version, which is almost always what you want: opening a project with a newer version of Godot than it was made with upgrades the project.

success.description: True if the project was already open, or a new editor instance was started for it

already_open.description: True if an editor was already running for this project, in which case headless, offscreen and offscreen_size were ignored and godot_version, if it was given, matched what that editor is running

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

list_open_projects.title: List Open Godot Projects
list_open_projects.description: Lists the projects currently open in a Godot editor, which version of Godot each one is open in, and whether that editor is headless or offscreen.

projects.description: The projects that are currently open in a Godot editor

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

project_name.description: The project's configured name; omitted if it couldn't be read

headless.description: True if the editor running this project is headless, so it has no visible window

offscreen.description: True if the editor running this project renders to a virtual display, so it has a window nobody can see

godot_version.description: The version of Godot this project is open in, named the way list_installed_godot_versions names it; omitted if the editor wouldn't say

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

list_installed_godot_versions.title: List Installed Godot Versions
description: Lists the versions of Godot that Godai can run: the ones it installed, and the custom builds that were linked with a name.
Versions are named the way the Godot downloads are: `4.5-stable`, `4.4.1-stable`, `4.6-beta3`, and `4.5-stable-mono` for a .NET build. A linked build is named by whatever it was linked as.
Use search_available_godot_versions to see the versions that could be installed.

versions.description: The versions of Godot that are installed or linked

version.description: The name this version is known by, which is what every other tool takes

reported_version.description: For a linked build, the version it reported when it was linked; absent if it wouldn't say

path.description: The absolute path to the Godot executable

templates.description: Whether this version's export templates are installed; absent for a linked build, whose templates aren't Godai's to know about

linked.description: True for a custom build that Godai didn't install

default.description: True if this is the version Godai uses when nothing else settles it

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

search_available_godot_versions.title: Search Available Godot Versions
description: Searches the versions of Godot that are available to install, newest first.
This searches the godotengine/godot-builds repository, so it sees versions that aren't installed yet. Use install_godot_version to get one.

filter.description: Only versions starting with this, so `4.5` finds 4.5 and 4.5.1, but not 3.4.5

include_prereleases.description: Include dev, alpha, beta and rc releases (default: false)

versions.description: The versions that can be installed, newest first

version.description: The name to pass to install_godot_version

installed.description: True if this version is already installed

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

install_godot_version.title: Install Godot Version
description: Downloads and installs a version of Godot.
This downloads hundreds of megabytes and can take several minutes.
If the user hasn't set a default version of Godot yet, this one becomes the default that Godai uses; the result says whether that happened.

godot_version.description: The version to install, as listed by search_available_godot_versions: `4.5-stable`, `4.4.1-stable`, `4.6-beta3`. A shorter `4.5` or `4.4.1` means the stable release. Add `-mono` for a .NET build, such as `4.5-stable-mono`, which the search doesn't list separately.

with_export_templates.description: Install this version's export templates too, which are only needed to export a project (default: false). A version that already has some templates is left as it is.

version.description: The name this version is known by, which is what every other tool takes

path.description: The absolute path to the Godot executable

templates.description: Whether this version's export templates are installed

linked.description: Always false for an installed version

default.description: True if this is the version Godai uses when nothing else settles it

became_default.description: True if there was no default version of Godot before, so this one became it

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

remove_godot_version.title: Remove Godot Version
remove_godot_version.description: Removes a version of Godot that Godai installed, or forgets a custom build that was linked with a name.

godot_version.description: The version or linked name to remove, as listed by list_installed_godot_versions

with_export_templates.description: Remove this version's export templates too (default: false)

version.description: The version or linked name that was removed

linked.description: True if this was a linked custom build, which was forgotten rather than deleted

templates_removed.description: True if this version's export templates were removed too

default_cleared.description: True if this was the default version of Godot, so there is no default now

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

pin_project_to_godot_version.title: Pin Project to Godot Version
description: Records in the project which version of Godot it is built with, so that Godai always opens it with that version.
This is written to a .godai.json config file in the project, which is meant to be committed, so that everyone working on it opens the same editor.

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

godot_version.description: The version or linked name to pin the project to, which must already be installed

success.description: True if the project was pinned to that version

godot_version.description: The version the project is now pinned to

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

unpin_project_from_godot_version.title: Unpin Project from Godot Version
unpin_project_from_godot_version.description: Removes the version of Godot recorded in the project's .godai.json config file, leaving Godai to work out which version to open it with from the project itself.

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

success.description: True if the project is no longer pinned to a version of Godot

was_pinned.description: True if the project was pinned to begin with

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

get_godai_settings.title: Get Godai Settings
description: Gets Godai's own settings, which configure Godai itself rather than anything inside the Godot project or editor.
Only the settings that can be changed at runtime are included; the rest come from command-line arguments.
Use set_godai_settings to change them.

godot_version.description: The version of Godot used by default, as named by list_installed_godot_versions; empty if none is configured

project_base_path.description: The base path where the user's Godot projects live; always empty unless MCP is running with --global

update_check.description: Whether godai checks for its own updates: "on", "off", or empty for the default (on)

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did

set_godai_settings.title: Set Godai Settings
description: Changes Godai's own settings, which configure Godai itself rather than anything inside the Godot project or editor.
Only the settings that can be changed at runtime can be set here; the rest come from command-line arguments.
Use get_godai_settings to see the current values.

godot_version.description: The version of Godot to use by default; it must already be installed, which list_installed_godot_versions shows

project_base_path.description: The base path where the user's Godot projects live; can only be set when MCP is running with --global

update_check.description: Whether godai checks for its own updates

success.description: True if the settings were changed and saved

errors.description: The errors that caused the call to fail; present instead of the other properties when it did
